title: Claude doubles PDF token charges; Microsoft releases free #anthropic #tokenbilling #pdfprocessing
description: Claude billed users twice for PDFs by converting each page into both an image and text, inflating token usage significantly. Microsoft released Mark It Down, a free tool that converts PDFs, Excel sheets, and Word docs into clean Markdown, removing page images and reducing token consumption to just the text. This fix preserves headings and tables, avoiding scrambled output. It also offers an MCP server for automatic conversion of files uploaded to Claude, streamlining workflows and cutting costs for users dealing with large documents. Mark It Down addresses a costly inefficiency in AI document processing, improving usability and affordability for professionals relying on Claude for contract review, data extraction, and similar tasks. #AnthropicClaude #MicrosoftMarkItDown #PDFtoMarkdown #AICostOptimization #TokenBilling #DocumentProcessing #ClaudeAI #MicrosoftFreeTool #MarkdownConversion #PDFConversion #ExcelProcessing #WordProcessing #AIDocumentTools #WorkflowAutomation #AITokenUsage
